content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

Dota 2 at EWC 26 returns to the Esports World Cup for its third year, featuring another elite field of international teams competing for global glory. Gaimin Gladiators took the inaugural Dota 2 title at EWC 2024, and Team Spirit won the championship in 2025 with a dominant run through the bracket.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Dota 2:

Dota 2 is a 5v5 multiplayer online battle arena where teams choose from 126 heroes across two roles: Core and Support. Each hero has a unique set of abilities that shapes their playstyle, and players work together to push lanes, defeat enemy heroes, and ultimately destroy the opposing team’s Ancient.
Dota 2 has one of the most passionate and competitive esports communities in the world, built on long-standing teams, rivalries, and massive prize pools.
The invoice will be shared within 7–14 business days.
The ticket holder is responsible for checking the date, time, and location.
Reselling the ticket is strictly prohibited.
Acknowledgment and adherence to the code of conduct.
The ticket holder, by attending the event, agrees on photographs, videos, and recorded audio that may be published online.

The organizing authority shall not be held responsible for physical injuries, illnesses, death, loss, or damage to possessions of any visitor (including the ticket holder) due to reasons related to or resulting from the event.
The organizing authority has the right to expel anyone whose behavior is considered by the organizing authority to be a violation.
Bringing outside food and beverages into the event is prohibited.
Animals are not allowed.
Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.
Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.
Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times.
Entry is free for children under 3 years old.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: Dota 2 at EWC 26
data.description:
Dota 2 at EWC 26 returns to the Esports World Cup for its third year, featuring another elite field of international teams competing for global glory. Gaimin Gladiators took the inaugural Dota 2 title at EWC 2024, and Team Spirit won the championship in 2025 with a dominant run through the bracket.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.


About Dota 2:
Dota 2 is a 5v5 multiplayer online battle arena where teams choose from 126 heroes across two roles: Core and Support. Each hero has a unique set of abilities that shapes their playstyle, and players work together to push lanes, defeat enemy heroes, and ultimately destroy the opposing team’s Ancient.

Dota 2 has one of the most passionate and competitive esports communities in the world, built on long-standing teams, rivalries, and massive prize pools.

content.value: Gates Open: Monday to Thursday
Friday to Sunday
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.
Football meets gaming in an exclusive EA FC showmatch featuring Karim Benzema.

On July 26 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, the excitement continues after the EA FC Finals as one of football's greatest icons steps away from the pitch and into the game. Watch Benzema compete live in front of the Paris crowd in a one-night-only showdown filled with big plays, fierce competition, and unforgettable moments.
Who will be on the other side of the controller? We're keeping that under wraps a little longer, but the reveal is coming soon.
One stage. One match. One unforgettable night.

Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.
Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.

All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: FC Pro World Championship at EWC 26
data.description:
Gates Open: Monday to Thursday: 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM
Friday to Sunday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM

Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.


Football meets gaming in an exclusive EA Sports FC showmatch featuring Karim Benzema.

On July 26 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, the action begins before the EA Sports FC Finals as one of football's greatest icons steps away from the pitch and into the game. Watch Benzema compete live in front of the Paris crowd in a one-night-only showdown filled with big plays, fierce competition, and unforgettable moments.

Who will be on the other side of the controller? We're keeping that under wraps a little longer, but the reveal is coming soon.

One stage. One match. One unforgettable night.

Please take note of the arena locations:
22-25 JUL, QIDDIYA CITY BATTLEGROUNDS
26 JUL FINALS, stc ARENA

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.
PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS at EWC 26 brings the world’s best teams together for high‑stakes battle royale action. Soniqs won the championship in 2024, while Twisted Minds was the last team standing in 2025.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS:

Every match of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS begins with teams dropping from an aerial craft onto an island filled with loot. Players scavenge for guns, armor, and grenades before hunting opponents, with strategic rotations, efficient looting, and precise gunplay separating the top teams from the rest.
On the EWC stage, seasoned pros face off for the chicken dinner and a share of the prize pool, delivering intense team fights and strategies.
The invoice will be shared within 7–14 business days.
The ticket holder is responsible for checking the date, time, and location.
Reselling the ticket is strictly prohibited.
Acknowledgment and adherence to the code of conduct.
The ticket holder, by attending the event, agrees on photographs, videos, and recorded audio that may be published online.

The organizing authority shall not be held responsible for physical injuries, illnesses, death, loss, or damage to possessions of any visitor (including the ticket holder) due to reasons related to or resulting from the event.
The organizing authority has the right to expel anyone whose behavior is considered by the organizing authority to be a violation.
Bringing outside food and beverages into the event is prohibited.
Animals are not allowed.
Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.
Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.
Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times.
Entry is free for children under 3 years old.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS at EWC 26
data.description:
PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS at EWC 26 brings the world’s best teams together for high‑stakes battle royale action. Soniqs won the championship in 2024, while Twisted Minds was the last team standing in 2025.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS:
Every match of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS begins with teams dropping from an aerial craft onto an island filled with loot. Players scavenge for guns, armor, and grenades before hunting opponents, with strategic rotations, efficient looting, and precise gunplay separating the top teams from the rest.

On the EWC stage, seasoned pros face off for the chicken dinner and a share of the prize pool, delivering intense team fights and strategies.

Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

Teamfight Tactics at EWC 26 marks the third year the game has been featured at the Esports World Cup, following Wolves Esports’ 2024 victory and Weibo Gaming’s 2025 championship. Unlike most TFT competitions, this event uses a team-based format where players work together in coordinated squads before advancing through the standard group and playoff stages.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Teamfight Tactics:

Players are challenged with a mix of strategy, tactical positioning, and resource management. Champions from League of Legends each bring unique abilities, and building the right team composition is essential. Synergies between units, combined with Augments, create opportunities to outmaneuver opponents. Every match unfolds over seven rounds, testing players’ ability to adapt, plan, and make every gold and champion count.

At the competitive level, only players who can master TFT’s intricate mechanics rise to the top. The Esports World Cup brings together the best of these strategists, showcasing intense matches where clever tactics and precise execution decide the victor.
The invoice will be shared within 7–14 business days.
The ticket holder is responsible for checking the date, time, and location.
Reselling the ticket is strictly prohibited.
Acknowledgment and adherence to the code of conduct.
The ticket holder, by attending the event, agrees on photographs, videos, and recorded audio that may be published online.

The organizing authority shall not be held responsible for physical injuries, illnesses, death, loss, or damage to possessions of any visitor (including the ticket holder) due to reasons related to or resulting from the event.
The organizing authority has the right to expel anyone whose behavior is considered by the organizing authority to be a violation.
Bringing outside food and beverages into the event is prohibited.
Animals are not allowed.
Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.
Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.
Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times.
Entry is free for children under 3 years old.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: Teamfight Tactics at EWC 26
data.description:
Teamfight Tactics at EWC 26 marks the third year the game has been featured at the Esports World Cup, following Wolves Esports’ 2024 victory and Weibo Gaming’s 2025 championship. Unlike most TFT competitions, this event uses a team-based format where players work together in coordinated squads before advancing through the standard group and playoff stages.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Teamfight Tactics:
Players are challenged with a mix of strategy, tactical positioning, and resource management. Champions from League of Legends each bring unique abilities, and building the right team composition is essential. Synergies between units, combined with Augments, create opportunities to outmaneuver opponents. Every match unfolds over seven rounds, testing players’ ability to adapt, plan, and make every gold and champion count.

At the competitive level, only players who can master TFT’s intricate mechanics rise to the top. The Esports World Cup brings together the best of these strategists, showcasing intense matches where clever tactics and precise execution decide the victor.

items.title: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang MSC at EWC 26

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

Mobile Legends: Bang Bang returns with MSC at EWC 26, where the world’s top squads will battle for international glory after Selangor Red Giants claimed the inaugural EWC MSC title in 2024 and Team Liquid PH followed up with a dominant win in 2025. Confirmed as an EWC title through 2027, who will join the ranks of champions in 2026?
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Mobile Legends: Bang Bang:

There are more than 125 heroes in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, but not every hero is built the same. Each hero fills a distinct role, from farming and roaming to crowd control and damage dealing, and success depends on how well they coordinate. Dominating in MLBB requires teamwork, timing, and strategic execution across all five roles.

High-level strategy is at the heart of MLBB gameplay. Teams pull off coordinated plays, push objectives, and power up their heroes to ultimately destroy the enemy base. With a passionate global esports community, MLBB continues to grow on the international stage, making every tournament a showcase of skill, strategy, and teamwork.

data.title: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang MSC at EWC 26
data.description:
Mobile Legends: Bang Bang returns with MSC at EWC 26, where the world’s top squads will battle for international glory after Selangor Red Giants claimed the inaugural EWC MSC title in 2024 and Team Liquid PH followed up with a dominant win in 2025. Confirmed as an EWC title through 2027, who will join the ranks of champions in 2026?

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Mobile Legends: Bang Bang:
There are more than 125 heroes in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, but not every hero is built the same. Each hero fills a distinct role, from farming and roaming to crowd control and damage dealing, and success depends on how well they coordinate. Dominating in MLBB requires teamwork, timing, and strategic execution across all five roles.

High-level strategy is at the heart of MLBB gameplay. Teams pull off coordinated plays, push objectives, and power up their heroes to ultimately destroy the enemy base. With a passionate global esports community, MLBB continues to grow on the international stage, making every tournament a showcase of skill, strategy, and teamwork.

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

Overwatch Champions Series MSC at EWC 26 brings together the world’s top Overwatch 2 teams to compete on one of esports’ biggest global stages, highlighting the game at its highest level. Overwatch has been part of the Esports World Cup for two years, with Crazy Racoons winning in 2024 and Team Falcons in 2025.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Overwatch 2:

Overwatch 2 is a 5v5, role-based hero shooter where success depends on teamwork and mastery of distinct roles. Players choose from Tank, Damage, and Support heroes, each bringing unique abilities that shape how every match unfolds. With a 42-hero roster, teams must adapt on the fly, counter opponents, and build compositions that fit the situation. Across competitive modes like Control, Escort, Flashpoint, Hybrid, Push, and Clash, players battle across 30 maps, coordinating ultimates and positioning to secure objectives and turn the tide of chaos in their favor.
Overwatch 2’s competitive scene is driven by one of the most passionate and enduring esports communities in the world.

Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.

data.title: Overwatch Champions Series MSC at EWC 26
data.description:
Overwatch Champions Series MSC at EWC 26 brings together the world’s top Overwatch 2 teams to compete on one of esports’ biggest global stages, highlighting the game at its highest level. Overwatch has been part of the Esports World Cup for two years, with Crazy Racoons winning in 2024 and Team Falcons in 2025.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Overwatch 2:
Overwatch 2 is a 5v5, role-based hero shooter where success depends on teamwork and mastery of distinct roles. Players choose from Tank, Damage, and Support heroes, each bringing unique abilities that shape how every match unfolds. With a 42-hero roster, teams must adapt on the fly, counter opponents, and build compositions that fit the situation. Across competitive modes like Control, Escort, Flashpoint, Hybrid, Push, and Clash, players battle across 30 maps, coordinating ultimates and positioning to secure objectives and turn the tide of chaos in their favor.

Overwatch 2’s competitive scene is driven by one of the most passionate and enduring esports communities in the world.

Call of Duty®: Warzone Resurgence Series at 2026 Esports World Cup continues the battle royale tradition at the Esports World Cup, where action‑movie intensity meets high‑stakes competition on the biggest stage. About Call of Duty®: Warzone:

It is a fast-paced battle royale where players select operators from the mainline games and drop into Verdansk, from shipping yards to wind farms. Teams build the best loadouts by looting weapons and unlocking perks as they level up, using strategy, movement, and firepower to outplay opponents and become the last squad standing.
COD Warzone’s competitive scene has grown into one of the most intense arenas in esports, with teams mastering rotations and teamwork under pressure.

items.id: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang MSC at EWC 26
items.title: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang MSC at EWC 26

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

Mobile Legends: Bang Bang returns with MSC at EWC 26, where the world’s top squads will battle for international glory after Selangor Red Giants claimed the inaugural EWC MSC title in 2024 and Team Liquid PH followed up with a dominant win in 2025. Confirmed as an EWC title through 2027, who will join the ranks of champions in 2026?
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Mobile Legends: Bang Bang:

There are more than 125 heroes in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, but not every hero is built the same. Each hero fills a distinct role, from farming and roaming to crowd control and damage dealing, and success depends on how well they coordinate. Dominating in MLBB requires teamwork, timing, and strategic execution across all five roles.

High-level strategy is at the heart of MLBB gameplay. Teams pull off coordinated plays, push objectives, and power up their heroes to ultimately destroy the enemy base. With a passionate global esports community, MLBB continues to grow on the international stage, making every tournament a showcase of skill, strategy, and teamwork.

Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.
Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times.
Entry is free for children under 3 years old.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: COD:WRS at EWC 26
data.description:
Call of Duty®: Warzone Resurgence Series at 2026 Esports World Cup continues the battle royale tradition at the Esports World Cup, where action‑movie intensity meets high‑stakes competition on the biggest stage. Team Falcons won the Warzone event at EWC 2024 and Twisted Minds claimed the title in 2025, setting the benchmark for the next champion.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Call of Duty: Warzone:
It is a fast-paced battle royale where players select operators from the mainline games and drop into Verdansk, from shipping yards to wind farms. Teams build the best loadouts by looting weapons and unlocking perks as they level up, using strategy, movement, and firepower to outplay opponents and become the last squad standing.

COD Warzone’s competitive scene has grown into one of the most intense arenas in esports, with teams mastering rotations and teamwork under pressure.

About Street Fighter 6:

The Street Fighter esports community is one of the most established in competitive gaming. Players from Japan, the Americas, Europe, and beyond will meet at EWC, where legacy competitors and rising stars clash.

items.id: Call of Duty: BO7 at EWC 26
items.title: Call of Duty: BO7 at EWC 26

content.value: Call of Duty, one of the most popular shooters in the world, returns for its third year at the Esports World Cup with COD BO7 at EWC 26. Atlanta FaZe won the Call of Duty event at EWC 2024, and OpTic Gaming claimed the 2025 title after a historic comeback, setting the stage for another fierce championship run in 2026.
Please note that there may be simultaneous matches happening on 6 AUG, split between the stc Arena and Qiddiya City Battlegrounds.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Call of Duty: Black Ops 7:

It is a fast-paced, tactical shooter where players choose from a cast of veteran characters, each with unique Perks that give an edge in combat. Scorestreaks allow players to vanish, throw unlimited shuriken, or see through walls, adding layers of strategy on expansive, realistic maps.

Competitive play centers on three modes: Search and Destroy, where one team defends bomb sites while the other attempts to plant them; Control, which challenges teams to capture two zones on the map; and Hardpoint, featuring rotating points that teams must hold to earn points.

Reselling the ticket is strictly prohibited.
Acknowledgment and adherence to the code of conduct.
The ticket holder, by attending the event, agrees on photographs, videos, and recorded audio that may be published online.

The organizing authority shall not be held responsible for physical injuries, illnesses, death, loss, or damage to possessions of any visitor (including the ticket holder) due to reasons related to or resulting from the event.
The organizing authority has the right to expel anyone whose behavior is considered by the organizing authority to be a violation.
Bringing outside food and beverages into the event is prohibited.
Animals are not allowed.
Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.
Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.
Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times.
Entry is free for children under 3 years old.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: Call of Duty: BO7 at EWC 26
data.description:
Call of Duty, one of the most popular shooters in the world, returns for its third year at the Esports World Cup with COD BO7 at EWC 26. Atlanta FaZe won the Call of Duty event at EWC 2024, and OpTic Gaming claimed the 2025 title after a historic comeback, setting the stage for another fierce championship run in 2026.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Call of Duty: Black Ops 7:
It is a fast-paced, tactical shooter where players choose from a cast of veteran characters, each with unique Perks that give an edge in combat. Scorestreaks allow players to vanish, throw unlimited shuriken, or see through walls, adding layers of strategy on expansive, realistic maps.

Competitive play centers on three modes: Search and Destroy, where one team defends bomb sites while the other attempts to plant them; Control, which challenges teams to capture two zones on the map; and Hardpoint, featuring rotating points that teams must hold to earn points.

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

2026 PUBG MOBILE World Cup at EWC brings together the world’s top PUBG MOBILE teams, where survival and strategy collide. Alpha7 Esports won the title in 2024, while Yangon Galacticos claimed the championship in 2025.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About PUBG MOBILE:

PUBG MOBILE is a battle royale game rooted in the original PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, bringing the core survival experience to mobile. Players drop into diverse locations across an island, looting guns, armor, and equipment while competing to outlast every opponent.
Top players from around the world converge at EWC to fight for the iconic “Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner,” showcasing survival skills, teamwork, and split-second decision-making on the global stage.

data.title: PUBG MOBILE World Cup at EWC 26
data.description:
2026 PUBG MOBILE World Cup at EWC brings together the world’s top PUBG MOBILE teams, where survival and strategy collide. Alpha7 Esports won the title in 2024, while Yangon Galacticos claimed the championship in 2025.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About PUBG MOBILE:
PUBG MOBILE is a battle royale game rooted in the original PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, bringing the core survival experience to mobile. Players drop into diverse locations across an island, looting guns, armor, and equipment while competing to outlast every opponent.

Top players from around the world converge at EWC to fight for the iconic “Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner,” showcasing survival skills, teamwork, and split-second decision-making on the global stage.

items.title: Honor of Kings World Cup at EWC 26

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

Honor of Kings returns for its third year at the Esports World Cup with KWC at EWC 26, uniting top teams from China and the rest of the world in a rare global showdown that is confirmed on the EWC calendar through 2027. After Chinese squads claimed the title in the first two editions, the pressure is on for new challengers to rise above the rest.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Honor of Kings:

Honor of Kings is a 5v5 mobile MOBA featuring a roster of more than 120 heroes across Tank, Fighter, Assassin, Mage, Marksman, and Support roles. Teams battle for objectives, manage waves of enemy mobs, and contest the jungle to gain advantages that snowball into late-game dominance.
As one of the largest mobile esports in the world and with a $3 million prize pool on the line, this event stands as a showcase of elite competition and its passionate global fanbase.

data.title: Honor of Kings World Cup at EWC 26
data.description:
Honor of Kings returns for its third year at the Esports World Cup with KWC at EWC 26, uniting top teams from China and the rest of the world in a rare global showdown that is confirmed on the EWC calendar through 2027. After Chinese squads claimed the title in the first two editions, the pressure is on for new challengers to rise above the rest.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Honor of Kings:
Honor of Kings is a 5v5 mobile MOBA featuring a roster of more than 120 heroes across Tank, Fighter, Assassin, Mage, Marksman, and Support roles. Teams battle for objectives, manage waves of enemy mobs, and contest the jungle to gain advantages that snowball into late-game dominance.

As one of the largest mobile esports in the world and with a $3 million prize pool on the line, this event stands as a showcase of elite competition and its passionate global fanbase.

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

TEKKEN 8 at EWC 26 returns for its third year at the Esports World Cup, with Lim “ULSAN” Soo-hoon entering as the two-time defending champion after winning both the 2024 and 2025 titles. ULSAN will look to extend his legacy as the field battles through the tournament’s standard group and playoff stages toward another shot at the crown.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About TEKKEN 8:

TEKKEN 8 continues the series’ long-running narrative while delivering fast, technical fighting built around deep character mastery. Each fighter brings a distinct style shaped by signature mechanics like Rage Arts, the Heat System, and split-second counterplay.

Players must balance aggression and defense, learning when to pressure opponents, convert openings into combos, and manage momentum across each round. Success depends on precision, matchup knowledge, and the ability to adapt instantly as fights escalate.

data.title: TEKKEN 8 at EWC 26
data.description:
TEKKEN 8 at EWC 26 returns for its third year at the Esports World Cup, with Lim “ULSAN” Soo-hoon entering as the two-time defending champion after winning both the 2024 and 2025 titles. ULSAN will look to extend his legacy as the field battles through the tournament’s standard group and playoff stages toward another shot at the crown.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About TEKKEN 8:
TEKKEN 8 continues the series’ long-running narrative while delivering fast, technical fighting built around deep character mastery. Each fighter brings a distinct style shaped by signature mechanics like Rage Arts, the Heat System, and split-second counterplay.

Players must balance aggression and defense, learning when to pressure opponents, convert openings into combos, and manage momentum across each round. Success depends on precision, matchup knowledge, and the ability to adapt instantly as fights escalate.

items.title: PUBG MOBILE World Cup at EWC 26

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

2026 PUBG MOBILE World Cup at EWC brings together the world’s top PUBG MOBILE teams, where survival and strategy collide. Alpha7 Esports won the title in 2024, while Yangon Galacticos claimed the championship in 2025.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About PUBG MOBILE:

PUBG MOBILE is a battle royale game rooted in the original PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, bringing the core survival experience to mobile. Players drop into diverse locations across an island, looting guns, armor, and equipment while competing to outlast every opponent.
Top players from around the world converge at EWC to fight for the iconic “Winner Winner, Chicken Dinner,” showcasing survival skills, teamwork, and split-second decision-making on the global stage.

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.

Rocket League at EWC 26 brings together the world’s top teams for high‑speed, acrobatic car soccer competition where teamwork and timing decide every match. Team BDS won the championship in 2024, and Karmine Corp claimed the title in 2025 with a dominant run through the grand final.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Rocket League:

Rocket League is a high-octane sports game where players control rocket-powered cars to score goals on a soccer field. Cars can flip, slide, and fly, with aerial hits and precise ball control playing a crucial role, and players must balance offense and defense in fast-paced, skill-driven matches.
The esports community around Rocket League has grown into a global competitive scene, with top teams from all over the world battling for dominance.

data.title: Rocket League at EWC 26
data.description:
Rocket League at EWC 26 brings together the world’s top teams for high‑speed, acrobatic car soccer competition where teamwork and timing decide every match. Team BDS won the championship in 2024, and Karmine Corp claimed the title in 2025 with a dominant run through the grand final.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Rocket League:
Rocket League is a high-octane sports game where players control rocket-powered cars to score goals on a soccer field. Cars can flip, slide, and fly, with aerial hits and precise ball control playing a crucial role, and players must balance offense and defense in fast-paced, skill-driven matches.

The esports community around Rocket League has grown into a global competitive scene, with top teams from all over the world battling for dominance.

content.value: Chess is coming to EWC 26 after debuting at EWC 25, where Magnus Carlsen, competing under Team Liquid, claimed the inaugural title. His victory helped establish chess as a natural fit on the EWC stage, blending classical mastery with modern esports competition.
Please note that there may be simultaneous matches happening on 11-14 AUG, split between the Allianz Vault and Qiddiya City Battlegrounds.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Chess:

Chess is an ancient game of wits, with both players thinking several steps ahead of their opponent to corner the King and get the Checkmate. Each piece has a different set movement, allowing players to knock out enemy pieces and close in on each other's King. Just remember, some promising knockouts could be a trap.

Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.
Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times.
Entry is free for children under 3 years old.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: Chess at EWC 26
data.description:
Chess is coming to EWC 26 after debuting at EWC 25, where Magnus Carlsen, competing under Team Liquid, claimed the inaugural title. His victory helped establish chess as a natural fit on the EWC stage, blending classical mastery with modern esports competition.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Chess:
Chess is an ancient game of wits, with both players thinking several steps ahead of their opponent to corner the King and get the Checkmate. Each piece has a different set movement, allowing players to knock out enemy pieces and close in on each other's King. Just remember, some promising knockouts could be a trap.

content.value: Gates Open:
Monday to Thursday:
Friday to Sunday:
Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.
R6 Siege at EWC 26 marks the third consecutive year of Rainbow Six at EWC, continuing a growing legacy for the tactical shooter on the global stage.

Following championship runs by Team BDS in the inaugural year and Team Secret in the second, the world’s top teams return to compete for the title, showcasing the strategic depth that defines Rainbow Six at the highest level.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege:
Since its release in 2015, Rainbow Six Siege has developed into one of the most established esports ecosystems in the world.
A tactical first person shooter built around preparation and team coordination, players choose from a roster of more than 70 operators, each defined by unique weapons, gadgets, and abilities.

Teams alternate between attacking and defending roles, with success relying on map knowledge, communication, and disciplined execution. Its realistic gunplay and fully destructible environments have established Rainbow Six Siege as a defining title in the competitive tactical shooter genre.

data.title: R6 Siege at EWC 26
data.description:
R6 Siege at EWC 26 marks the third consecutive year of Rainbow Six at EWC, continuing a growing legacy for the tactical shooter on the global stage. Following championship runs by Team BDS in the inaugural year and Team Secret in the second, the world’s top teams return to compete for the title, showcasing the strategic depth that defines Rainbow Six at the highest level.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Siege X:
Since its release in 2015, Rainbow Six Siege has developed into one of the most established esports ecosystems in the world. A tactical first person shooter built around preparation and team coordination, players choose from a roster of more than 70 operators, each defined by unique weapons, gadgets, and abilities.

Teams alternate between attacking and defending roles, with success relying on map knowledge, communication, and disciplined execution. Its realistic gunplay and fully destructible environments have established Rainbow Six Siege as a defining title in the competitive tactical shooter genre.

content.value: CS2 at EWC 26 marks the third year of Counter-Strike competition at the Esports World Cup. Following title wins by Natus Vincere in the first year and The MongolZ in the second, the world’s top teams return to compete for the championship in a tournament that highlights Counter-Strike’s highest level of play.
Please note that there may be simultaneous matches happening on 19-20 AUG, split between the stc Arena and Qiddiya City Battlegrounds.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Counter-Strike 2:

Counter-Strike 2 is a round-based tactical shooter in which teams take turns attacking and defending bomb-sites. Meanwhile, they must manage a team economy from which they buy all their weapons, armor, and utility. The game features a variety of different maps with many potential strategies, emphasizing precise aim and intelligent teamplay to win.
CS2's esports scene continues to thrive through deep rivalries and an experienced global fan base.

content.value: The invoice will be shared within 7–14 business days.
The ticket holder is responsible for checking the date, time, and location.
Reselling the ticket is strictly prohibited.
Acknowledgment and adherence to the code of conduct.
The ticket holder, by attending the event, agrees on photographs, videos, and recorded audio that may be published online.

The organizing authority shall not be held responsible for physical injuries, illnesses, death, loss, or damage to possessions of any visitor (including the ticket holder) due to reasons related to or resulting from the event.
The organizing authority has the right to expel anyone whose behavior is considered by the organizing authority to be a violation.
Bringing outside food and beverages into the event is prohibited.
Animals are not allowed.
Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.
Tickets are transferable and non-refundable, and you may return as many times as you like with a valid ticket.
Children under 16 must be accompanied at all times.
Entry is free for children under 3 years old.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.

data.title: Counter-Strike 2 at EWC 26
data.description:
CS2 at EWC 26 marks the third year of Counter-Strike competition at the Esports World Cup. Following title wins by Natus Vincere in the first year and Team Vitality in the second, the world’s top teams return to compete for the championship in a tournament that highlights Counter-Strike’s highest level of play.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About Counter-Strike 2:
Counter-Strike 2 is a round-based tactical shooter in which teams take turns attacking and defending bomb-sites. Meanwhile, they must manage a team economy from which they buy all their weapons, armor, and utility. The game features a variety of different maps with many potential strategies, emphasizing precise aim and intelligent teamplay to win.

CS2's esports scene continues to thrive through deep rivalries and an experienced global fan base.

About CROSSFIRE:

Players purchase weapons and tactical grenades such as smokes and flashes each round, allowing teams to execute structured strategies and adapt on the fly.
At the highest level, CROSSFIRE’s esports scene showcases players who have mastered aim, movement, and coordination to gain mechanical advantages in decisive moments.

data.title: CROSSFIRE at EWC 26
data.description:
CROSSFIRE at EWC 26 brings top teams together for a tactical FPS tournament, with disciplined execution and clutch decision-making defining the path to the title. At EWC 25, AG.AL emerged as champions, defeating BaiSha Gaming to claim the CROSSFIRE crown.

Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.

About CROSSFIRE:
CROSSFIRE centers on bomb-based attack-and-defense gameplay, with one team working to plant and detonate the objective while the other does everything possible to stop it. Players purchase weapons and tactical grenades such as smokes and flashes each round, allowing teams to execute structured strategies and adapt on the fly.

At the highest level, CROSSFIRE’s esports scene showcases players who have mastered aim, movement, and coordination to gain mechanical advantages in decisive moments.

This season’s Trackmania World Tour has showcased intense rivalries and global competition, with leaderboards and points determining qualification for elite events. Now, at the Esports World Cup, the world’s best Trackmania racers will push for glory on a fresh international stage, bringing more thrilling finishes to fans everywhere.
Premium perks:
- Fast Track entry to arena
- Goodiebag with limited edition souvenirs included while stocks last.
About Trackmania:

In Trackmania, drivers race solo or as teams against the clock and other competitors on wildly inventive courses filled with jumps, loops, and hairpin turns, where split‑second decisions and flawless runs define success. The game’s free-to-play model and the millions of hours watched on streaming platforms underscore its growing appeal in the racing genre.

The Trackmania competitive scene has deep roots, with a structured World Tour that spans regional events and culminates in marquee races attracting top drivers from around the world. Familiar clubs like Karmine Corp, Spacestation Gaming, Alliance, and more have previously fielded teams across the circuit, blending established esports brands with the fast‑paced racing format.

The game’s free-to-play model and the millions of hours watched on streaming platforms underscore its growing appeal in the racing genre.

The Trackmania competitive scene has deep roots, with a structured World Tour that spans regional events and culminates in marquee races attracting top drivers from around the world. Familiar clubs like Karmine Corp, Spacestation Gaming, Alliance, and more have previously fielded teams across the circuit, blending established esports brands with the fast‑paced racing format.

Football meets gaming in an exclusive EA FC showmatch featuring Karim Benzema.

On July 26 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, the excitement continues after the EA FC Finals as one of football's greatest icons steps away from the pitch and into the game. Watch Benzema compete live in front of the Paris crowd in a one-night-only showdown filled with big plays, fierce competition, and unforgettable moments.

One stage. One match. One unforgettable night.

data.title: FC Pro World Championship at EWC 26
data.description:
Gates Open: Monday to Thursday: 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM
Friday to Sunday: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM

Gate opening times may vary. Please refer to your ticket for the exact gate opening time.


Football meets gaming in an exclusive EA Sports FC showmatch featuring Karim Benzema.

On July 26 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, the action begins before the EA Sports FC Finals as one of football's greatest icons steps away from the pitch and into the game. Watch Benzema compete live in front of the Paris crowd in a one-night-only showdown filled with big plays, fierce competition, and unforgettable moments.

Who will be on the other side of the controller? We're keeping that under wraps a little longer, but the reveal is coming soon.

One stage. One match. One unforgettable night.

Please take note of the arena locations:
22-25 JUL, QIDDIYA CITY BATTLEGROUNDS
26 JUL FINALS, stc ARENA

content.value: The EWC26 Fan Fest is where the Esports World Cup experience comes to life beyond the competition.

Join fans from around the world at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles and explore a vibrant celebration of gaming, creators, clubs, and community. Discover interactive gaming experiences, exclusive publisher showcases, creator appearances, cosplay, community tournaments, challenges, and live entertainment across multiple activation zones.
Meet your favorite creators, connect with fellow fans, represent your club, try new games, and take part in unforgettable experiences designed for every kind of esports fan.
Whether you're attending for the competition or simply looking to immerse yourself in gaming culture, the EWC26 Fan Fest is your destination for non-stop entertainment throughout your visit.
The invoice will be shared within 7–14 business days.
The ticket holder is responsible for checking the date, time, and location.
Reselling the ticket is strictly prohibited.
Acknowledgment and adherence to the code of conduct.
The ticket holder, by attending the event, agrees on photographs, videos, and recorded audio that may be published online.

The organizing authority shall not be held responsible for physical injuries, illnesses, death, loss, or damage to possessions of any visitor (including the ticket holder) due to reasons related to or resulting from the event.
The organizing authority has the right to expel anyone whose behavior is considered by the organizing authority to be a violation.
Bringing outside food and beverages into the event is prohibited.
Animals are not allowed.
Smoking is prohibited in all areas of the event and its facilities.
Tickets are non transferable, non cancellable, and cannot be used for re-entry.
No professional cameras or video recorders are permitted at the venue without a permit.
Parking is available.
All purchases are final and non-refundable, except in cases of organizer-related technical or operational issues.
